state_reset: Before EVERY query mj_resetData; rebuild identical full continuous-branch FK qpos for that pose; qvel,ctrl,act,qacc_warmstart,qfrc_applied,xfrc_applied all zero before setting the declared ctrl6. Keep original solver/physics/actuator limits/equalities/PD/DR untouched. Verify same qpos bytes and zero warmstart across four queries per pose.
model: Single original authoritative XML normal boot, retain ground/all geoms/equalities, only compiler.meshdir resolved to normal asset directory. No Plant/controller/DR construction; no raw/H5/DR sample reads; no asset rehash or 279-mesh traversal.
contact: Record ncon and contact names for every query. Intended airborne rows require actual ncon=0, not just world-contact exclusion. If contact or changed constraint stage appears, preserve result and qualify/mark interpretation unknown; never remove contacts/constraints to force air.
frame: Resolve floating_base compiled joint qposadr/dofadr and base_gyro sensor site/frame; record actuator joint IDs, axes, gears, transmission/gain/bias/dynamics. At root identity/qvel0, verify root rotational Jacobian columns and cross-check qacc[dofadr+4] against local/world chassis angular acceleration Y after explicit mj_rnePostConstraint/mj_objectAcceleration. No additional forward or rotated-velocity experiment.
response: For each unit-pair row subtract SAME pose ctrl0 qacc. Root Euler pitch ddot equals angular Y ddot only at this queried identity orientation/zero velocity. Record full qacc and six actual hinge qacc, plus crank-minus-hip ddot differences. Units rad/s^2; input is +1 Nm PER selected motor, total +2 Nm per symmetric pair after gear/actuator_force verification.
linear_scope: Finite +1-vs-zero nominal instantaneous control response with original soft constraints/passives. Compare efc types/states and solver residuals; do not certify arbitrary amplitude/other poses/negative direction/sustained dynamics from these 12 rows.
sign_rule: For a scalar pair increment u=k*positive_pitch_error and measured local coefficient a=delta_pitch_ddot/u, restoring local sign requires a*k<0. If coefficient is zero/uncertain or stages differ, mark sign unknown. No gain magnitude selected or controller implemented.
wheel_limits: Report wheel angular acceleration with root reaction but do not infer sustainable speed/momentum/electrical/signed-DC authority or D4 driver behavior. Direct model unit ctrl is not full inverse-PD/processed-target/D4 motor torque tracking.
parent_context_not_recomputed: R60 fresh16 only10/16 local; old8 seed7/8 is not strong robustness evidence. No event/episode data read for this task.
